shots.action: Lies on a cot, turns his head toward the hull to listen, sits up, rubs his face with both hands, stands.
shots.line: That thump. Pump's still running. Okay. Still running.

shots.action: Walks to the wall manifold, scans four analog gauges left to right, taps one glass with a finger.
shots.line: Manifold first. Pressure's holding, scrubber needle is in the green. Good. Boring is good.

shots.action: Raises his left wrist, presses the dive watch twice with his right hand, looks down at it, exhales.
shots.line: Watch says fifteen meters, and the nitrogen is climbing like it does every hour. Seventeen hours to decompress when I finally go up. Not today.

shots.action: At the lab bench, lifts a small recorder to his mouth and speaks, counting items off with his free hand.
shots.line: Day one log. Diesel tank, 2000 litres, burning 2 litres an hour. Desalinator makes 20 litres of water a day. Pantry count: 700 meals. Do the math later. Math is for later.

shots.action: Looks up at an announcement, turns toward a wall panel where a red fault lamp blinks, lowers the recorder, walks over.
shots.line: (Station) Hydrophone array, channel three, no signal.

shots.action: Works at the telemetry panel, pulls a bus tray out and pushes it back with both hands, presses the lamp; it turns green.
shots.line: Channel three. I wrote this firmware. Of course it's channel three. Reseat the bus, clear the fault, don't take it personally.

shots.action: Grips a yellow valve wheel on the intake bulkhead, strains twice, it does not move; steps back and shakes out his hand.
shots.line: Intake bulkhead valve is seized. Zebra mussels, probably. Manual crank, then.

shots.action: Braced with knees bent, hauls the wheel hand over hand; it moves in jerks that get faster.
shots.line: Come on. Come on. There. It's moving. Slow and steady, nobody's timing me.

shots.action: Walks to the centre of the room, looks up through the acrylic dome, takes half a step back and holds still. Dark human silhouettes drift against pale green light above. No gore, shapes only.
shots.line: Okay. Look up. Just once. ...They're still up there. Hundreds of them, blocking the light. Not coming down. They can't come down.

shots.action: Looks down, walks back to the bench, speaks into the recorder, sets it down, glances up over his shoulder at the dome.
shots.line: End of entry. Lab 04 is stable. Supply boat comes in three weeks. I just have to keep the lights on until then.
